title: Code-world edit: a cut-in with a safe gap
subtitle: Lyft Level 5, suburban arterial, daytime · 126 keyframes at 5 Hz, rendered at 12 Hz · single agent session (Claude Opus 5.5)
task: Edit the scenario in code: the car overtaking in the adjacent lane merges into the ego lane ahead of the ego with a safe gap.

steps.label: Plan
steps.text:
The edit should make one vehicle in an adjacent same-direction lane, ahead of the ego, merge into the ego lane with a safe gap. Procedure: (1) screen the 16 candidate scenes for such a vehicle early in the model window (keyframes 0-76); (2) inspect the chosen vehicle, the ego lane and the lane geometry of `map_features.json`; (3) write the edit as appended lines of `scene_world.py`; (4) check it with `sanity.py` (gaps to every agent and to the ego, on-road fraction, divider crossings, visibility) and revise until clean; (5) render original and edited conditions and the BEV with `make_case.py` and inspect them.
Plausibility targets: a lane change of about 4-5 s with a peak lateral speed below 1.5 m/s, no new overlap, no crossing of a road divider, and a following headway of at least about 1 s after the merge.
kv: Lyft Level 5, 16 candidate scenes, code worlds from SceneClaw-edit
code world 5 Hz (126 keyframes); render 12 Hz (299 frames); model window 185 frames
keyframe 0, the ego path and the static world are not editable

steps.label: Candidates
steps.text: Most candidates either travel alongside the ego at the same speed or overtake late in the window (keyframe 39 or later). In scene a004-...838138 a sedan overtakes the ego on the left from keyframe 12 at about 3 m/s faster than the ego, on a sunny arterial with three lanes per direction; it is selected. A late overtaker in an overcast scene (a009-...297198) and a slow side-by-side follower (a004-...842367) are kept as alternatives.

steps.label: A free lane with a bus 50 m ahead
steps.text:
The ego drives in the right travel lane; to its right are only parked vehicles (0 m/s, about 3 m to the side). The ego lane is free up to a 10.3 m bus that stays about 50 m ahead at the ego's speed. The sedan is centred about 3.8 m to the left, in the adjacent lane, and is 1 m ahead at keyframe 3 and 10.5 m ahead at keyframe 18.
Design: `lane_change(-3.8)` over keyframes 18-40 (4.4 s, peak lateral speed 1.4 m/s). At the midpoint the sedan is about 15 m ahead of the ego's front bumper and still pulling away, so the merge leaves a gap of more than 1 s.

steps.label: Check: the sedan reaches the bus
steps.text: The merge itself is clean (no off-road frames, one lane-divider crossing, no road-divider crossing, gap to the ego unchanged). The sedan, however, keeps its original 16 m/s in the ego lane and closes on the bus, which travels at about 12.5 m/s. From 12 Hz frame 158 it overlaps the bus. The edit therefore also requires the sedan to adapt its speed after merging.

media.label: sanity.py, v1: gap of the sedan to the nearest other agent per 12 Hz frame

steps.label: Edit v2: ease off behind the bus
steps.code:
# SAW: at 16 m/s in the ego lane the sedan overlaps the
#      bus from frame 158

# 1. same lane change, then 16.0 -> 12.8 m/s at 0.8 m/s^2
car.lane_change(-3.8, t0=18, t1=40)
for t in range(28, 48):
    car.set_speed(16.0 - 0.16 * (t - 27),
                  from_t=t, to_t=t + 1)
car.set_speed(12.8, from_t=48)

# 2. check, then render the case
sanity.py --scene ... --edited scene_world_v2.py
#    -> no overlap; gap to the bus settles at 18 m
make_case.py --scene ... --case cutin --wait
#    -> CHECK OK, 139 changed frames in the window

steps.label: Check: safe, but the sedan settles far ahead
steps.text: The overlap is removed; the sedan follows the bus at 18 m (1.4 s) and stays 22-23 m ahead of the ego. In the rendered canvases the merged sedan is small at this distance: the edit changes at most 17,866 pixels per frame (mean 8,842 over the 139 changed frames in the model window). To make the cut-in clearly visible while keeping it polite, the deceleration should begin during the lane change, so that the sedan settles closer to the ego.

steps.label: Check: gaps, road and dividers
steps.text: The sedan crosses the lane divider at frame 74, about 14 m ahead of the ego's front bumper and still pulling away, and settles 16-17 m ahead (1.3 s at 12.6 m/s), 23-25 m behind the bus. The only gaps below 1 m (frames 96-112) are lateral clearances to a parked RV on the right; the ego passes the same RV at 0.58 m. Later in the clip, outside the model window, the gap to the ego closes to 12.8 m because the ego accelerates slightly.

# ==== code-world edit (cutin): the overtaking sedan in the
#      left lane merges into the ego lane ahead of the ego,
#      easing off to the speed of the traffic (0.9 m/s^2)
car = scene.agent('1fc847f8277b...')
car.lane_change(-3.8, t0=16, t1=38)  # kf 16 -> 38 (4.4 s)
for t in range(22, 40):              # 16.0 -> 12.6 m/s
    car.set_speed(16.0 - 0.19 * (t - 21),
                  from_t=t, to_t=t + 1)
car.set_speed(12.6, from_t=40)       # keep pace
